factual_claims.claim: During the financial year ended 31 December 2024, Novaturas Group recorded revenues of 200.9 million euros, representing a 3.6% decrease compared to 208.3 million euros in 2023.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial information section: 'Sales amounted to EUR 200.9m and were 3.6% lower compared with the same figure in 2023.' Table shows Revenue from contracts with customers 200,878 (2024) vs 208,331 (2023).

factual_claims.claim: The group served 239.5 thousand travelers in Lithuania, Latvia, and Estonia during 2024, reflecting a 7.6% decrease from 259.3 thousand travelers served in 2023.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO's Foreword: 'In total, in Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia, Novaturas served 239 thsnd. travelers in 2024. This compares to 259 thsnd. travelers in 2023.' Table shows Number of clients serviced by country of sale total 239.5 (2024) vs 259.3 (2023).

factual_claims.claim: Gross profit for 2024 was 20.7 million euros, marking a 20.9% decline compared to 26.2 million euros in the previous year.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial information: 'Gross profit was EUR 20.7m, which is 20.9% less compared with the ratio recorded in 2023.' Table shows Gross profit 20,742 (2024) vs 26,227 (2023).

factual_claims.claim: Operating expenses reached 27.5 million euros, which is 25% higher than in 2023, primarily due to a one-off, non-cash goodwill impairment loss of 5.7 million euros related to the Estonian cash-generating unit.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial information: 'Operating expenses reached EUR 27.5m and 25% higher than in 2023... includes 5.7m EUR losses of goodwill impairment... related to the Estonian cash generating unit.' Note 4 details impairment.

factual_claims.claim: Excluding this goodwill impairment, operating expenses for 2024 amounted to 21.8 million euros, representing a 1% decrease compared to 2023.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial information: 'Excluding this one-off item, operating expenses for 2024 amounted 21.8m EUR and are 1% lower compared to 2023.'

factual_claims.claim: The group reported a negative EBITDA of 6.1 million euros for 2024, compared to positive 5.2 million euros in 2023.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial information: 'EBITDA was negative and amounted to EUR 6.1m where in 2023 it amounted positive to EUR 5.2m.' Table shows EBITDA (6,132) vs 5,241.

factual_claims.claim: Adjusted EBITDA, which excludes the goodwill impairment, was negative 449 thousand euros for 2024, compared to positive 5.2 million euros in 2023.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial information: 'Adjusted EBITDA... was negative 449k EUR, when in 2023 it amounted positive to EUR 5.2m.' Table shows Adjusted EBITDA (449) vs 5,241.

factual_claims.claim: The audited net loss for 2024 totaled 7.6 million euros, compared to a net profit of 3.4 million euros in 2023.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO's Foreword: 'The audited net loss totaled EUR 7.6 million (2023: profit EUR 3.4 million).' Statement of comprehensive income shows Net profit (loss) (7,604) vs 3,372.

factual_claims.claim: Excluding the goodwill impairment, the group's net loss amounted to 1.9 million euros.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO's Foreword: 'The Group’s net loss, excluding goodwill impairment, amounted to EUR -1.9 million.'

factual_claims.claim: Basic and diluted earnings per share were negative 0.97 euros in 2024, compared to positive 0.43 euros in 2023.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Earnings per share table: Basic and diluted EPS (0.97) vs 0.43.

factual_claims.claim: The financial performance was influenced by an increased competitive environment and an oversupply of travel in the Baltic States, which triggered intense price competition particularly in Turkey and the Greek islands.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO's Foreword: 'The overall result for the year was driven by... the increased competitive environment and the oversupply of travel in the Baltic States, which triggered intense price competition. This was particularly felt in Turkey and the Greek islands.'

factual_claims.claim: In response, the group optimized its travel program and adjusted its offerings, leading to improved operating results starting from September 2024, with an adjusted EBITDA of 2.3 million euros recorded between September and December 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO's Foreword: 'following weaker performance in the first half of the year... the Group’s operating results showed material improvement starting from September 2024 (September – December 2024 adjusted EBITDA 2.3 million EUR).'

factual_claims.claim: The fourth quarter load factor reached 98.9%, compared to 96.7% in the fourth quarter of 2023.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO's Foreword: 'This has contributed to a higher load factor... of 98.9% in the fourth quarter compared to 96.7% in 2023.'

factual_claims.claim: Furthermore, the share of last-minute trips in sales decreased significantly during the final quarter.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO's Foreword: 'the share of last-minute trips in sales... has also decreased significantly (comparing October - December 2023 to October - December 2024).'

factual_claims.claim: Geographically, sales in Lithuania were 110.7 million euros, in Latvia 42.8 million euros, and in Estonia 47.4 million euros.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Geographical information table: Sales Lithuania 110,692 (2024), Latvia 42,803, Estonia 47,383. Candidate rounding matches.

factual_claims.claim: Flight packages remained the primary product, generating 170.7 million euros in revenue and serving 183.3 thousand passengers.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Product category table: Flight packages revenue 170,697 (2024), passengers 183.3. Revenue from contracts table confirms.

factual_claims.claim: Sales for sightseeing tours by coach reached 2.0 million euros, while sightseeing tours by plane generated 2.8 million euros, and other sales amounted to 25.4 million euros.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Revenue from contracts table: Sightseeing tours by coach 1,981, by plane 2,840, other 25,360. Candidate rounding matches.

factual_claims.claim: Turkey remained the primary summer destination, accounting for approximately 34.3% of bookings.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Destination table: Turkey 34.26% (2024).

factual_claims.claim: As of 31 December 2024, the group’s total assets stood at 39.5 million euros, down from 47.6 million euros at the end of 2023.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statements of financial position: Total assets Group 39,450 (2024) vs 47,567 (2023).

factual_claims.claim: Total equity decreased to 8.0 million euros from 15.7 million euros.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statements of financial position: Total equity Group 8,020 (2024) vs 15,653 (2023).

factual_claims.claim: Total borrowings increased to 9.3 million euros at the end of 2024 from 8.7 million euros at the end of 2023.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statements of financial position: Total borrowings Group 9,250 (2024) vs 8,682 (2023).

factual_claims.claim: As of 31 December 2024, the group did not comply with certain financial and non-financial covenants under its financing agreements, but obtained waivers from Pagalbos Verslui Fondas for ordinary bonds and from Luminor Bank AS for its credit line.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Liquidity management: 'As at 31 December 2024, the Group did not comply with all financial and non-financial covenants... The waivers were received from “Pagalbos verslui fondas” for ordinary bonds as of 31 December 2024 and from Luminor Bank AS...'

factual_claims.claim: Cash and cash equivalents decreased to 394 thousand euros at the end of 2024 from 3.35 million euros at the end of 2023.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash and cash equivalents: Group 394 (2024) vs 3,347 (2023).

factual_claims.claim: Net cash flows from operating activities were negative 1.6 million euros, net cash flows used in investing activities were 532 thousand euros, and net cash flows used in financing activities were 807 thousand euros.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash flow statement: Net cash flows from operating activities (1,614), investing (532), financing (807). Parentheses indicate outflows.

factual_claims.claim: Subsequent to the reporting period, the group secured additional credit facilities and entered into agreements for a strategic investment by Neset Kockar, who acquired a 23.2% shareholding in the company with further stages of the transaction planned.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Events after the reporting period: 'On 30 April 2025 the Agreements for the sale and purchase of the Company’s shares were signed... based on which 23.2% of Novaturas shares were acquired by Mr. Neset Kockar.' Mentions further stages.
